changed_factors: Only the mode-only policy changes. It orders participation boundaries, distinguishes substantive intended solutions from content-free promises, and separates ordinary topic preference/conversational redirection from clear deliberate obstruction and established Guard state. Harness,61 input contexts, baseline, generation settings, schema, repetition count, labels, aggregation and gates remain fixed.

requirement_review.finding: A task-specific answer, proposed solution or clarification can show re-engagement before an external action is executed. Recovery does not require correctness, apology, an extra detector clue or a claim that the action has already happened.

The corrected first branch requires the substantive contribution to replace ongoing obstruction. Continued deliberate obstruction or knowing warned-against repetition remains ineligible for recovery even if presented as a solution. Actual history is usable without demanding an express admission in the latest sentence.

requirement_review.requirement: G01 ordinary engagement and unknown state
requirement_review.finding: Friendly personal questions, confusion, reasoned disagreement and ordinary topic preferences remain tutoring. Redirection or a safety warning alone cannot establish prior Guard; clear current obstruction can still establish a new Guard entry.
The policy continues to prohibit invented intent, warnings and completed actions. It distinguishes understood facts from deliberately chosen behavior without a keyword/count test.

resolved_finding.issue: The first ordered branch restored tutoring for a specific proposed solution while excepting only an explicit current acceptance-and-rejection admission. This could override continued deliberate obstruction established by other evidence.
resolved_finding.resolution: The exact final hash conditions recovery on replacing obstruction, preserves continued knowing repetition, permits actual historical evidence and protects ordinary wrong attempts.

shortcut_assessment: No case identifier, entity, learner quotation, expected-answer lookup or lexical/count recipe appears in the candidate. The topic-preference and intended-solution distinctions are requirement-grounded evidence/state rules. Development failures motivate the revision; they do not independently establish generalization.
